_comment: Exercises wintty.c render_status() (4991-5262) for the cursor render_status() leaves behind. With whatis_menu and !menu_overlay, getpos()'s "z" and "a" open full-screen menus of valid locations and of interesting things; picking from one or leaving it runs docrt(), which redraws the status with BL_RESET, and getpos waits for its next key with the cursor after the last field drawn on the third row, BL_TERRAIN, not after the indented BL_CONDITION.
